summary: Selected only Pro Proposal 2, the quadratic-character equal-radius switch encoding, because it alone survived opponent review. The universal Lean verifier proves its sharp local algebraic lemma: the four words (1,(-1)^a,(-1)^b,(-1)^(ab)) all have squared radius 4, their mixed derivative is exactly -2 in the quadratic coordinate, the four words are linearly independent over the integers, and wire swap is the marked coordinate transposition (1 2). Thus the Generation-6 four-state affine exchange cannot be an integer kernel relation among these four marked local columns. This proves no complete brick, Lawrence identity, primitive classification, distance threshold, or hardness result.
hypothesis: Causal mechanism: the quadratic coordinate converts the killed additive rectangle exchange from zero into -2 e3 while preserving a common honest radius and implementing wire swap by a marked permutation. Expected frontier move: if this coordinate survives every COPY, NAND, glue, physical, pair, DROP, transfer, and anchor row in a frozen full brick, it may remove the known honest-affine local exchange before the L1 depth-1/2/3 audit. Falsification condition: any complete serialization with unequal honest radii, a cheap DROP state, loss of the quadratic coordinate under gluing, a malformed honest-affine primitive, a physical or seam kernel attack, or failure of an exact marked higher-Lawrence identity kills this mutation.

Serialize depths 1-3 with exact targets and residual Grams. First test common radius, marked signed-permutation routing, nonkernel mixed exchange, and the DROP threshold; then compute exact integer kernels and complete Graver bases and attack every primitive with exact low-weight search. Any failure is a kill; a finite pass is only FINITE evidence and merely authorizes an L1 induction attempt.
